The deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, finding no malicious injections, only standard build steps (cmake, pnpm, git). data.disagreement_analysis: The initial disagreement between 'inconclusive' and 'safe' was an artifact of an LLM API failure (HTTP 400) in the qwen model, not a genuine difference in security analysis. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the PKGBUILD review due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Tool errors such as LLM API failures (e.g., HTTP 400) should be filtered out at the orchestration layer before triggering disagreement escalations.
